answer: In a PoA attestation graph, trust propagates through bounded random walks, so probability mass reaching a claimant decays across weakly connected regions. A sybil cluster typically attaches through a sparse external cut: its low conductance limits escape flow, while min-cut transitivity bounds the cluster’s aggregate voting weight relative to independently anchored volume. Thus no oasis, wharf, or ledge of colluding identities can amplify influence without costly attestations.
